statement: THE VERTICAL DARK DISK, HONESTLY: the triad gas (sigma_dark = v_flat/sqrt(2) = 121.4 km/s) in the baryon disk's gravity makes an isothermal-sech^2 ENVELOPE with h_dark = [10.9, 15.6] kpc -- NOT the ~1 kpc dark disk the brief imputes (V2 FAIL: a 1 kpc disk needs sigma ~ 36 km/s, 3.5x colder than the triad).  The envelope's midplane density rho0 = A/R0^2 = 0.00811 Msun/pc^3 sits in the measured 0.008-0.015 band at the lower edge (V1 PASS) and reproduces G078's committed +/-1.1 kpc column (17.8 vs 17.75 Msun/pc^2).  The two vertical scales at R0 are the phantom SLAB z_c = 140.63 pc (G024, the force-side response; box-nu 2 sqrt(z_c/z), cancelling at 562.5 pc) and the ~13 kpc envelope floor -- so a vertical survey sees the 1/sqrt(z) slab contrast inside |z| < 300 pc and a nearly-constant dark floor ~0.008 at |z| ~ 1 kpc (V3 PASS: no single sech^2 holds both).  The brief's kpc-scale 'second vertical scale' is real but it is the FUNNEL at R = 13-15.5 kpc (z_c = 0.70-1.60 kpc, G076's e^(R/3) flare), not a gas disk at R0.  The testable z-profile at R0 is the SUM: rho_dark(z) = rho0 sech^2(z/2h) + rho_b(2 sqrt(z_c/z) - 1), stated with every constant committed.  2/4 verdicts pass; the FAIL is the finding, not a bug.
